results.why: The claim states that in push-to-stage mode an external promoter must move changes and, when it lags, auto-sync immediately applies whatever the stage branch last held, which is the planted stale-manifest chain.
The claim states that Reverse waits for each Application to be fully deleted before advancing and that a child stuck Progressing makes that wait never complete, leaving a half-deleted ApplicationSet.

The claim states the same collision between the impersonation design's narrow least-privilege credentials and Server-Side Diff's need for patch authority on every resource kind, producing recurring diff failures whose only remedy is widening the credential impersonation set out to narrow.

The claim states that the rollback push happens outside the commit server and so lands unsigned, is rejected on a signature-requiring branch, and leaves the operator with an unexplained failed push and no retry.
